name: Lake Erie

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: New York Riesling generally has a light body and a light, mellow flavor.

blurb.text: A multi-state AVA along Lake Erie's southern shore across New York, Pennsylvania and Ohio. It includes the Chautauqua-Erie Grape Belt and holds Grand River Valley and Isle St. George.
